description:
The settings of one layer file, holding only the fields that file sets

`settings.json` is the global layer's file and `projects/<id>/settings.json`
one project's. These types are what the schema is written from, so a file
kelpie reads can hold nothing they do not describe.

$schema.description: The schema this file is written against

bridge-updates.description: Where each bridge's new versions come from, keyed by the bridge's registry id such as `claude-acp`. A bridge the map does not name takes `registry-automatic`.

harness-global-folder.description: Whether a harness may read the global config folder it keeps for itself: Claude Code's `~/.claude`, or `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` when the person set it, and goose's `~/.config/goose`. Each applies when the session next starts.

host.description: The host a provider runs on

lease-capacity.description: How many commands hold each lease at once, keyed by the lease's name such as `cargo-test`. A lease the map does not name takes kelpie's own capacity for it, and no lease holds zero.

network-allowlist.description: Domains a sandbox request may reach, one saved with *Allow for this project*

pm-effort.description: How much effort the PM puts in, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the effort to the harness.

pm-harness.description: Which harness the PM's next message runs on. Where it is empty, the `pm` agent's own harness decides.

pm-model.description: Which model the PM runs on, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the model to the harness.

provider.description: Where a harness's model runs, for a harness that reaches a model through a server

read-anywhere.description: Whether an agent may read anywhere by default, instead of only what its work touches

reply-style.description: How kelpie asks a harness to phrase its replies

worker-effort.description: How much effort a worker puts in, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the effort to the harness.

worker-harness.description: Which harness a worker runs on. Where it is empty, the `worker` agent's own harness decides.

worker-model.description: Which model a worker runs on, named as the harness names it. Empty leaves the model to the harness.

worker-slots.description: How many of this project's workers run at once. A worker that is Paused or waiting on the maintainer holds no slot. 0 holds every worker out of the project's slots.
